msg.note_text: This notice shows while the switch is on and hides when its text is empty
ui.toast_failed: That did not work. See data/log.txt.
ui.desc_button: One primary per screen, full width at the bottom. Secondary for the rest; a confirm for anything destructive.
ui.use_button: Use for: A verb the user does now
ui.not_button: Not for: Settings (use a toggle), navigation (use a row)
ui.desc_row: A row runs an action or opens a screen. The header carries one text link or up to two icons.
ui.use_row: Use for: Lists of actions and settings
ui.desc_menu: Hold a list row 600 ms for Nickel's popup. Items that do not apply are hidden. Remove… goes last and asks first.
ui.not_menu: Not for: The main action of a screen
ui.desc_toggle: A real on/off setting that takes effect at once. The whole row is the target.
ui.not_toggle: Not for: Running an action, or choices with three values (use radio)
ui.desc_radio: Two to eight exclusive options; a sub-line explains one.
ui.use_radio: Use for: Choosing one of a few options
ui.not_radio: Not for: More than 8 (use a list screen), yes or no (use a toggle)
ui.desc_field: Short values on Nickel's keyboard. Go commits. Long or secret values go through pairing.
ui.use_field: Use for: Names, numbers, short URLs
ui.desc_pair: The phone fills the form; the Kobo shows only the address and a one-time code.
ui.use_pair: Use for: Tokens and long values typed on the phone
ui.not_pair: Not for: Short values (use a field)
ui.desc_toast: Nickel's toast, 3 seconds, at most one per 2 seconds. For results that need no action.
ui.not_toast: Not for: Errors the user must read, or questions
ui.desc_dialog: Nickel's dialog: serif title, text, Cancel left, the verb right. 120 s without an answer means Cancel.
ui.use_dialog: Use for: Destructive or irreversible choices
ui.dlg_text: An info dialog has one button; tapping outside it closes it
ui.desc_notice: The only grey box. One tip per screen; hidden when its text is empty.
ui.use_notice: Use for: Tips and non-blocking warnings
ui.not_notice: Not for: Errors that block, or headings
ui.desc_steps: Progress as text, at most one update every 5 seconds. No bar, nothing moves.
ui.use_steps: Use for: Work that takes a while
ui.not_steps: Not for: Percentages, or anything that updates faster than every 5 seconds
ui.desc_empty: Never a blank page: heading, one hint, one button.
ui.empty_text: Add books on the phone, then sync
ui.use_empty: Use for: A list or screen with nothing in it yet
ui.nav_p1: Back returns to the page you came from, at the page you were on.
ui.nav_p2: Tapping a tab clears the stack and opens that tab.
ui.nav_p3: Turning a page sends no event: it is the screen itself, not the app.
ui.desc_navigation: Back returns one level; a tab tap clears the stack. Pages turn with the pager or the page keys; dialogs ignore keys.
ui.not_navigation: Not for: Navigation inside a page
ui.desc_text: Heading in Nickel's serif, body and caption in the sans. Text wraps; it never scrolls.
ui.txt_body: Body text wraps to as many lines as it needs and never scrolls away.
ui.not_text: Not for: Anything the user must act on
ui.desc_kv: Sections group rows; key–value rows show facts, value bold at the right.
ui.use_kv: Use for: Facts: device, address, version
ui.not_kv: Not for: Values the user must read in full (use text)
ui.desc_code: Codes you read aloud or scan. Big code 144 px mono; QR 480 px with a text address under it.
ui.use_code: Use for: PINs and addresses to read or scan
ui.not_code: Not for: Anything longer than 12 characters
ui.desc_list: Rows from the app's state: primary left, secondary right. Tap runs an action; hold opens the menu.
ui.use_list: Use for: Rows that come from the app state
ui.desc_gallery: Tiles 3:4; the current one gets a 4 px border and Nickel's check. Tap opens the viewer; hold opens the menu.
ui.gallery_empty_text: Copy PNG files (1 MB or less) into Pictures, then tap the refresh icon
ui.title: UI Kit
